moments.title: UK braces for new heatwave
moments.blurb: A widespread heatwave is set to hit England and Wales next week, with temperatures potentially reaching 36°C by Thursday, while Scotland and Northern Ireland expect rain.

angles.name: Heatwave Arrival
angles.copy: Sun's out, thermometers up! A new heatwave is on its way across England and Wales, with some areas hitting a scorching 36°C by Thursday. Stay cool and hydrated!

angles.name: North-South Split
angles.copy: While England and Wales bake in a new heatwave this week, our friends in Scotland and Northern Ireland are bracing for spells of heavy rain. What's your forecast looking like?

moments.title: The Hundred cricket tournament heats up
moments.blurb: The Hundred 2026 cricket competition continues across the UK, with matches scheduled throughout the week leading up to the finals on August 16th.

angles.name: Weekend Matches
angles.copy: The Hundred is in full swing this weekend! Catch MI London vs Trent Rockets and Southern Brave vs Manchester Super Giants tomorrow. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Welsh Fire
angles.copy: Are you following Welsh Fire in The Hundred? The action continues this week as teams battle for a spot in the August 16th finals. Get behind your team!

moments.title: Boardmasters Festival concludes
moments.blurb: Boardmasters Festival, a popular surf and music event in Cornwall, wraps up this Sunday, August 9th, after five days of live music and beach culture.

angles.name: Boardmasters Wrap Up
angles.copy: It's the final weekend for Boardmasters Festival in Cornwall! Who's there soaking up the last of the surf, sun, and sounds before it wraps on Sunday?

angles.name: Cornwall Vibes
angles.copy: Boardmasters is bringing the best of music and surf to Cornwall this weekend. What's been your highlight if you've been down there?

moments.title: Rebellion Punk Festival ends
moments.blurb: The iconic Rebellion Punk Music Festival in Blackpool concludes this Sunday, August 9th, bringing four days of punk rock to fans from around the world.

angles.name: Punk Rock Finale
angles.copy: The legendary Rebellion Punk Festival wraps up this Sunday in Blackpool! Who's been rocking out and what's been your favourite set?

angles.name: Blackpool Punk
angles.copy: Four days of pure punk rock bliss in Blackpool! If you're at Rebellion this weekend, make some noise!

moments.title: Roots Picnic makes UK debut in London
moments.blurb: The globally celebrated Roots Picnic festival makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, this weekend (August 8-9), blending hip hop, music, and culture.

angles.name: Roots Picnic Hits London
angles.copy: Big news for London's music scene! The Roots Picnic makes its UK debut this weekend at Crystal Palace Bowl. Get ready for a blend of hip hop and culture!

angles.name: Crystal Palace Bowl
angles.copy: Crystal Palace Bowl is buzzing this weekend as Roots Picnic brings its unique vibe to London. Who's heading down for the international debut?

moments.title: Summer holidays winding down for some
moments.blurb: UK summer school holidays continue for most, but pupils in Wales return to school by August 11th, and Scottish students return from August 13th.

angles.name: Back to School Wales
angles.copy: Enjoying the last few days of freedom? Pupils in Wales are heading back to school by August 11th! Tell us your best summer holiday memories!

angles.name: Scotland Back to School
angles.copy: Not long now! Scottish pupils return to school from August 13th. How have you made the most of the summer break?

moments.title: Bruce Dickinson turns 68
moments.blurb: Iron Maiden's iconic frontman, Bruce Dickinson, celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Bruce
angles.copy: Up the Irons! Bruce Dickinson, the legendary voice of Iron Maiden, turns 68 today. What's your favourite Maiden track?

angles.name: Metal Icon
angles.copy: From pilot to heavy metal icon, Bruce Dickinson is 68 today! Celebrate with an Iron Maiden classic!

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jacquie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 66th birthday to Jacquie O'Sullivan, formerly of Bananarama! What's your favourite hit from the iconic 80s group?

angles.name: Happy Birthday Shawn
